reviews.title: Update required time after time
reviews.text:
Who would think why you are forced to “update “ this app so often, weekly it seems, just to open it to see when the race starts. I’m not interested at all in gambling, which it seems is now the business interest being enabled by the nascar app’s required frequent updates. Enough, my interest is waning, miss racing with “stock cars”. I’m thinking Tony is right.
And now that the 2026 season is underway, I find my Sunday’s are free to get outside and do things. My perfectly functioning iPhone 8 is deemed to old to work with nascar’s app, the logical way to follow the show 
along. If I’m interested I can recap the race elsewhere in very little time with no ads. I’m getting to prefer this. Bye bye.

reviews.title: No Air Camera in 2023? Why not?
reviews.text:
I’ve used the different NASCAR race apps, since they’ve become available. Although it’s great to see the annual cost come down dramatically, I was not happy to see that this year you’ve taken away the access to the aerial camera shots from the blimp or chopper’s. Will that be coming back? It give’s a much different perspective of what is going on on the track than the in car camera’s offer. The aerial view of the track & surrounding areas is also nice to see. It is nice having the in car cameras during commercials, you don’t miss anything. 

I do like being able to listen to the tower & being able to hear the behind the scene work that goes on before and during the race.
If you do have a favorite driver, hearing that communication can being interesting, not only driver to spotter, but also spotter to crew chief gives you insight to strategy.

Please give us the option of the aerial views!
I will go to 5 stars if you put it in!

reviews.title: Insufferable, loaded with Ads
reviews.text: Guys, are you trying to grow the sport or not? Doing so by placing intrusive ads in your own proprietary app that blocks 1/3 of the screen, ones that you cannot close… is not the way. Embarrassing. I’m not finished with the app. Was the $0.01 you earned for it worth it?  Worse, your content is ONLY trashy short form videos that yes, ALSO have ads for 15-30 seconds before anything plays. Am I asking too much to have ANY form of real journalism here in the for of written stories? Yikes. Please do better. Quit spamming all of us. NASCAR content is extremely difficult to find on all the major other sites. Stop making it so hard for us to consume decent, journalist content on your own dang platform.
